patterns.message: Framework-agnostic boundary: src/engine, src/interactions, src/bus, src/windows, src/menus and src/dev must not import a UI framework. Vue was REMOVED from this project (docs/remove-vue-plan.md) — these patterns stay as a ratchet so it cannot creep back. All UI here is plain TS + DOM; see docs/ARCHITECTURE.md.
Framework-agnostic boundary: no UI framework here. See docs/ARCHITECTURE.md.

src/dev is SCAFFOLDING and must delete cleanly: nothing in engine/, interactions/ or bus/ may import it (CLAUDE.md, docs/ARCHITECTURE.md). The engine declares what it wants measured — see src/engine/RenderProbe.ts — and App.ts injects the instrument.

patterns.message: Framework-agnostic boundary: no UI framework here. See docs/ARCHITECTURE.md.
src/dev is SCAFFOLDING and must delete cleanly: the score layer may not import it. See src/engine/RenderProbe.ts for the seam.
Score layer must not import a renderer, audio, the editor's facade, an interaction controller or the UI bus. The arrow points editor -> score, never score -> editor — docs/DESIGN-PRINCIPLES.md §5.
